companyDescription: Cardiorenal · lorundrostat, a selective aldosterone synthase inhibitor for uncontrolled/resistant hypertension — PDUFA Dec 22, 2026; second-to-market behind AstraZeneca baxdrostat
priceNote: Live $15.52 on Nov 11, 2026, near the bottom of its $14.91–$47.65 52-week range. Market cap is ~$1.45B against $625M cash (EV ~$0.8B). The Dec 22 PDUFA is 41 days out.
summary: The Dec 22, 2026 PDUFA for lorundrostat (hypertension) is the catalyst. The stock is -67% from its high since AstraZeneca's baxdrostat launched first. The consensus mean is ~$48.50 (BofA $49, UBS $29), which implies ~+210%. That figure is stale (Aug 2026), but even UBS's $29 clears the 20% gate (+87%). EV is ~$0.8B for a mass-market hypertension drug with 48-week OLE data of -17.8 mmHg (AHA 2026), and $625M cash funds the launch into 2028. The catalyst is 41 days out, at the edge of the 42-day window and well outside the 14-day North Star, so a backtest miss there is a horizon artifact. Core Base bias is +23.7pp vs realized 14d P75 +6.6%, so Base is a ~4–8 week post-earnings re-rating horizon, not a 14-day call. Also carried in the turbo lane today; size it once across both. Size 2–3%.

catalysts.name: Lorundrostat PDUFA — hypertension
catalysts.description: The NDA (add-on for uncontrolled/resistant hypertension) has a PDUFA target action date of Dec 22, 2026. Review is underway per the Nov 8 update, and a sales force is being built ahead of the date.

risks: Second to market behind AstraZeneca's baxdrostat, so approval is a re-rating event, not a monopoly.
Label risk (hyperkalemia monitoring) could cap the re-rate.
A CRL would mean ~-40–50% for a single-asset company.

macroRisk.rateOutlook: The Fed held at 3.75–4.00% on Oct 28. After the hot Oct CPI on Nov 10, CME FedWatch prices a +25bp hike at the Dec 9 FOMC at ~89–100%, with ~10% odds of 50bp. The 10-year is ~4.98%.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Oct CPI: headline +0.4% m/m, core +0.3% m/m vs 0.2% expected. Sep core PCE was 3.1% y/y. Oct PCE on Nov 25 is the next print, then Nov CPI on Dec 10, the day after FOMC.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Single-asset cardiorenal biotech moving to launch, funded into 2028. Rates matter through the biotech multiple only.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — the PDUFA lands after the Dec 9 FOMC and Dec 10 CPI, so macro volatility comes first and may offer a better entry.
